name: hcs-track-log
description: Cargo & package tracker on Hedera: shipment events are notarized as blind SHA-256 commitments on a multi-sig HCS topic, cached in Postgres, and verified by recomputing each hash from content.

envVars.description: .env. Hedera network: testnet, previewnet or mainnet (default testnet).
.env. Operator account id (0.0.x) that pays fees and creates the topic.
.env. Operator private key (DER or hex). Placeholder only in .env.example; never commit a real key.
.env. Topic id (0.0.x) printed by `npm run topic:create`.
.env. Comma-separated public keys of every authorized submitter. Becomes the topic's threshold submit key.
.env. Number of submitter signatures required per message (1..N).
.env. Comma-separated private keys this server signs submissions with. Must meet HCS_SUBMIT_THRESHOLD.
.env. Mirror node base URL used for verification (default https://testnet.mirrornode.hedera.com).
.env. Test database for `npm run test`; its schema is dropped on every run and its name must end in _test (default postgres://hcs:hcs@localhost:5432/hcs_track_log_test).
.env. Bearer token (at least 32 chars) required by the write API. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

steps.text: hcs-track-log uses the Hedera Consensus Service directly; there are no Solidity contracts to deploy. Postgres is required.

steps.label: Copy the env file and fill in your operator account and submitter keys
Dev only: generate a 2-of-3 set of submitter keys and paste the printed lines into .env
Create the HCS topic with the multi-sig submit key, then set HCS_TOPIC_ID in .env
Optional: anchor a demo parcel on HCS and cache it
Verify every event on the topic from the command line
Read the architecture and trust model
